name: spawn-piece
description: After 50 frames G.cur.col must be non-zero (col=3 after spawn). Uses cur.col at _G+204 rather than cur.id (_G+200) because PIECE_I has id=0 making a nonzero-id check unreliable. Struct layout: board[20][10]=200 bytes, then cur.id(2 bytes)=off200, cur.rot(1)=202, cur.row(1)=203, cur.col(1)=204.
